pathAssistantSteps.info:
Send Claim Notification to Market

  • Email the finalized SOC/PLA to all applicable reinsurers
  • Confirm successful delivery and log correspondence

Document Sent Status

  • Update system status to reflect advice has been sent
  • Ensure all reinsurers are marked as “advised” in the record

Reconcile Policy & Underwriting Year

  • Match the claim to the appropriate policy and underwriting year
  • Review any discrepancies and resolve them before allocation

Allocate Claim to Reinsurers

  • Assign the claim shares based on treaty/program structure
  • Confirm allocation details before issuing documents

Issue SOC/PLA to Reinsurers

  • Distribute the SOC/PLA to reinsurers
  • Include all required claim documentation and post for records

Respond to Market Inquiries

  • Monitor and respond to follow-up questions from reinsurers
  • Provide clarifications or additional documentation as requested

Track Market Acknowledgements

  • Record confirmation or acknowledgement responses from the reinsurers
  • Maintain communication logs and update claim status accordingly

Receive Cedant SOC/PLA

  • Obtain the Statement of Claim (SOC) or Proof of Loss Advice (PLA) from the Cedant
  • Verify the document and save it in the system

Generate Cedant SOC/PLA Record

  • Create a new record for the received SOC or PLA
  • Ensure key fields (Policy No, Loss Date, Claim Amount) are accurately entered
